counting: Pre-start Attack+Health; Belly sum is recursive and excludes hand. Alive means seated before R12 combat.
growth: R14 survivors matched to R8, also a common seed cohort surviving R14 in every arm; no zero imputation.
ledger: Direct eating plus accepted Elder shares, minus recycled already-attributed meals. Sales remove own credit only; contents release. Eliminated is permanent inventory loss before R12. Destroyed credit is inferred from the stock deficit only in turns with explicit recruit destroyed events. Combat deaths do not destroy recruit stats. Visible credit is bounded by the body's displayed A+H (an upper bound, because other gains coexist); stored attributed credit beyond that is reported separately as cap_excess.

provenance.roster: Ooze engine and Pot Luck, Birds, Fairies, Bog, Hedgerow and Hunters engine lines, plus varied Hard; seed-shuffled; all tribes enabled.
provenance.numeric_safety: Applied existing 1e9 stat maximum before Ooze own-stat, Soup, eat/share, Hasty and Granny vector conversion; no bot policies changed. Same corrected source for all arms.
provenance.arm_c: Every ordinary positive growth/count/economy dial is 3x t3; golden Aspic is 1+2*bonus, golden Elder remains a 2x twin; Posset share capped at 1, Moss reduction at 75%, Hasty releases after 1 death. Loop guards retained.
provenance.sampling: Same seed ids and seating; purchases desynchronize shop streams. Growth uses seeds with observed R8 and R14 in all arms, without zero imputation.
